name: crew
description: A standing team of expert colleagues for a project: subagents with a profile, a memory and a todo, who review the work at milestones, take tasks by priority and talk with you one-to-one or in meetings; with the Crew panel: the team with portraits, who is at work and the steps they report, the reports, the tasks and their backlog (with the project plugin's too), and meetings drawn as a group chat; in eleven languages.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; the panel's own settings page overrides it
